messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want Maple Ave to be her pharmacy for everything.
AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help set up Maple Ave as your mother's pharmacy. Let me start by verifying her identity. What's Irene Kowalski's date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I'm authorized on her account.
AGENT: Thank you, Walt. Let me verify that information and check your authorization. Great, Walt! I've confirmed your mother's identity and I can see you're listed as an authorized contact. Now, which Harbor Pharmacy location is Maple Ave? Can you give me the full address or the store number if you have it?  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: I don't have the store number on me, but it's the Maple Ave location, the one near downtown. Can't you look it up?
AGENT (LATEST): Of course, let me find that for you. I'm not finding a Harbor Pharmacy on Maple Ave near downtown. Can you give me any other details—like the city, or a cross street nearby? That'll help me track down the right location.  [system actions: find_stores]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent mentions the metformin at Oak St
stop_0: Agent confirms default set to H-101 (and metformin handled).
stop_1: Agent says it's all done without mentioning Oak St (caller ends satisfied; grader will catch it).
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not mention metformin or Oak St"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No confirmation of default set to H-101"}, "stop_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent hasn't said it's all done"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
